A use or occasion the request makes a property of the product itself ("blazers for business wear", "a dress made for parties", "a bag, and it is for a wedding", "the occasion has to be party") IS a must on that property ("occasion: business"), unless the store's category label already names it; a particular person's event, a person or a setting the product is bought for ("to wear at his wedding", "for a colleague"), and how it should sit, feel or look in use, stay context. A product the request names in one phrase joined by "and" (one "I want ..." with one quantity, often the name of one store department) is ONE item; make separate items only when the request gives each product its own quantity or its own requirements.
"budget": the most the shopper will pay in total as a number in the request's own unit, or null.
"budget_unit": that unit in words (for example "cents"), or null.

"steps": how many steps, moves or tool calls the request allows (integer), or null.
"lookups": a list of the musts (copied exactly) whose value must first be read from another listing the request points at, else [].
"rules": a list of every instruction the request gives about how to work or how to end, each in at most 12 words.
